{{Top|leg}}
'''Tri-beam lasers''' were a type of [[Mining laser/Legends|mining laser]] used on the [[Tagge Mining Company]] [[AEA-500 mineral extractor]]. The tri-beam lasers were used to remove waste material from mineral deposits.
